card.text: Explore Cybele in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Cybele is a main-belt asteroid. Explore its calibrated nonconvex reconstruction from DAMIT, version 2017-09-21. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. This displays the 2017 reconstruction at its released scale. Newer SPHERE work reports a smaller, more oblate shape.

shape.title: DAMIT model 1843
shape.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
